title: docs: update README — 2026-10-03
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily README update: Latest News and star history. Recent Apps is refreshed when an app is published.

gist.headline: The garden noticeboard gets updated
gist.blurb: The README’s Latest News gets its daily refresh, alongside the light and dark star-history charts. The noticeboard remains well tended.
gist.summary: The October 3 README update refreshes Latest News and both star-history SVGs, keeping the repository’s front page current.
gist.impact: Repository visitors get current news and star-history charts in both light and dark themes.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden noticeboard represents the repository README, with a small news sheet and two star-history charts for light and dark themes. Polli, wearing a tiny editor’s visor, pins up the update beside a code-plant.
gist.image_prompt: Polli pins a fresh news sheet beside two little star-history charts on a garden noticeboard, with a code-plant growing below. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
